# Devinno.UI {{VERSION}}

> SkiaSharp-based .NET 9 UI library for industrial HMI touch panels and general apps. A screen = XML markup (.dvml) + CSS-like inline `style` + C# view-model binding.

The documents below sit in the same folder as this file (the package's `docs/`, or `.devinno/Devinno.UI/` in your project after a build). Read them in this order.

1. [llm-rules.md](llm-rules.md): authoring rules. **Read first.** Principles, differences from CSS, what is silently ignored and what shows up as magenta or an exception, common mistakes, how to check a screen by rendering a PNG, known limits.
2. [dvml-ui-markup.md](dvml-ui-markup.md): markup reference. Full list of tags, attributes, style keys, values, defaults, binding syntax, handler signatures and theme tokens, with examples. Assume anything not listed there does not exist.
3. [dvml-process.md](dvml-process.md): process diagram (P&ID, `DvProcess`) authoring guide. Read it before building a process screen.
4. Devinno.UI.xml: C# API reference (XML doc comments, the same text IntelliSense shows). Detailed usage of DvApp, DvPage, DvBar, DvDialog, DvSurface, DvRenderer, DvTheme, AlarmLog, TrendBuffer, DvStrings, ComponentRegistry, DvWidget (custom widgets drawn in C#) and others.

To show screens in a window, an app also references one host adapter package, each with its own `llms.txt`: Devinno.UI.OpenTK (`ViewWindow`) or Devinno.UI.WinForms (`ViewControl`).
